caption:
Only one craft has ever visited Neptune.

Voyager 2 flew past Neptune in 1989. It came closest on 25 August.
Neptune and Triton show as thin, sunlit crescents.
Clouds ring the south and a storm swirls above the pole.

What the astronomers say: this scene is built from Voyager’s flyby images, with stars from a sky survey in Camelopardalis.

NASA picture of the day, 21 Nov 2026. Assembly/Processing - Rolf Olsen, Data - Voyager 2, NASA Planetary Data System.
